partners.diseaseBName: autosomal recessive limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type R18
partners.mechanism_chain: GDI1 (HGNC:4100) —DISRUPTS→ Rab GTPase regulation and trafficking (GO:0007246); Rab GTPase regulation and trafficking (GO:0007246) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); TRAPPC11 (HGNC:22763) —DISRUPTS→ Protein trafficking (GO:0006898); Protein trafficking (GO:0006898) —LEADS_TO→ Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy (HP:0003745); Rab GTPase regulation and trafficking (GO:0007246) —BINDS→ Protein trafficking (GO:0006898).
